Validate a forward-blocking-attention raw-data bundle

Source: R/fba-validators.R
validate_fba_rawdata.Rd

Runs every check that build_fba_rawdata() runs when it builds a bundle, so that a bundle can be validated again, e.g. after it was read from disk, after exclusions were recorded or before any analysis.

Usage

validate_fba_rawdata(x, silence = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A catlas_fba_rawdata object, from build_fba_rawdata().

silence

Logical(1). Suppress the message confirming that the bundle passed. Defaults to FALSE (recommended).

Value

x invisibly if no check aborts, otherwise an informative error.

Details

Checks shared by every catlas_rawdata bundle

The provenance record, the three components (meta, stimuli, trials) and their required columns, identifiers aligned across the components, no participant-identifying columns such as e-mail addresses, platform metadata, batches aligned with the provenance, participant metadata, response times and the uniqueness of stimulus mappings.

Checks of the forward-blocking-attention design

  • The study belongs to the fba family and every stage of the design is present (abort).

  • Trial counts lie within the bounds derived from the provenance (warn).

  • Every participant saw every cue and used every outcome option (warn).

  • Compound cues are counterbalanced left and right (abort for complete runs of a design whose stages all have an even number of blocks, warn otherwise).

  • Test trials present only the test pairs of the design, and is_correct agrees with the blocking expectations recorded in the design registry (abort).

  • Confidence ratings lie on the scale of the design (abort), and every answered test trial carries one (warn).

Warnings do not stop the validation, so read them. The message confirming that the bundle passed refers to the checks that abort only.

See also

build_fba_rawdata(), record_exclusion()
